items.title: Nakheel unveils Palm Springs masterplan in southern Dubai
items.summary: A 3.8m sq m residential masterplan next to Palm Jebel Ali with 15 neighbourhoods of villas, townhouses and apartments for about 50,000 residents. Unit count and prices were not disclosed.

items.title: Beyond launches Shione, US$817m project on Dubai Islands
items.summary: Two residential buildings of 20 and 21 storeys with 603 homes, offering 1-3 bedroom apartments and 3-4 bedroom duplexes. Second phase of the Siora beachfront masterplan.

items.title: H&H opens sales at Rosewood Residences on Dubai Peninsula
items.summary: Private residences in the 85-hectare Dubai Peninsula masterplan, which also includes hotels and a marina. Sales launched with average prices of about AED 10,000 per sq ft; unit count not stated.

items.title: Damac plans AED 3bn creek-side project in Al Zorah, Ajman
items.summary: Land deal for a mixed-use waterfront scheme; phase one comprises two towers with 421 studio to 3-bedroom apartments and loft units, expected to launch in Q1 2027.

items.title: Samana and Maserati unveil Maserati Island on The World Islands
items.summary: Branded island development with 840 residences plus water and tree villas. The first release is 232 sea-facing residences with private pools, from studios to four-bedroom units.

items.title: Playa Viva on track for first Al Marjan Island handover
items.summary: Most units are sold and the project is in its final sales phase. Handover is targeted for Q2 2027, before Wynn Al Marjan Island opens. Units are sold turnkey and fully furnished.
